name: schur-cg
description: Exact elimination of the largest fixed effect; preconditioned conjugate gradients on the reduced normal equations for y and all regressors together, with an approximate Cholesky factorization of each large sparse fixed-effect block's Laplacian (Kyng-Sachdeva/AC sampling) and dense exact small blocks; reghdfe df_a conventions. Threads: NUMBA_NUM_THREADS and BLAS.
